crossRefs.note: Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah…
The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh’s word in your mouth is truth.”
When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.
As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as…

translations.web: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
translations.bsb: And the dead man sat up and began to speak! Then Jesus gave him back to his mother.
translations.kjv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
